title: Missing moeb tool: read_absolute_path
description: Used external Read tool (Claude Code MCP) to read truncated start_spec output at absolute system path C:\Users\Simeon\.claude\...\tool-results\mcp-moeb-start_spec-*.txt. No moeb equivalent exists for reading files at absolute paths outside the project directory. This causes moeb-tool-origin to fail for every spec invocation where start_spec output is large enough to be truncated by the MCP host.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a mechanism for the MCP server to serve large tool result outputs directly without requiring the client to read from absolute system paths outside the project directory.
resolution_summary: Superseded by consolidated signal a1000056: read_file and read_file_range cover in-project reads; absolute-path gap tracked separately.
